en.hubeali: H 14460 – A group, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad, from his father, from Abu Muhammad has narrated:

Abu Abdullahasws having said when asked about the Statement of Allahazwj: “[91:1] I swear by the sun and its brilliance,”, said: ‘The sun (is a reference to) the Messengersaww of Allahazwj by whomsaww Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Clarified for the people their Religion’.

‘I then asked, ‘(What about) “[91:2] And the moon when it follows the sun”? Heasws said: ‘That is Amir-ul-Momineenasws following the Messengersaww of Allahazwj, and emitted the knowledge by reradiating (like moon reflects the rays to the earth which fall on its surface from the sun)’.

‘I then asked, ‘(What about) “[91:4] And the night when it draws a veil over it”?’ Imamasws said: ‘That (is a reference to) the imams of the injustice who tyrannised by the command the Progenyasws of the Messengersaww and seated themselves upon a set which was for the Progenyasws of the Messengersaww whoasws were higher (more deserving) for it than them. They veiled the Religion of Allahazwj by the injustices and the tyranny. So Allahazwj has Referred to their deeds by Saying “[91:4] And the night when it draws a veil over it”.

‘I then asked, (What about) “[91:3] By the Day as it shows up (the Sun's) clarity”?’ Heasws said: ‘That (is a reference to) the Imamsasws from the descendants of Fatimaasws, when asked about the Religion of the Messengersaww of Allahazwj so they clarify it for the one who has asked (from themasws). So Allahazwj has referred it in Hisazwj Statement by Saying “[91:3] By the Day as it shows up (the Sun's) clarity”.
en.sarwar: 12. A group, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad, from his father, from Abu Muhammad has narrated: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) having said when asked about the Statement of Allah (azwj): “[91:1] I swear by the sun and its brilliance,”, said: ‘The sun (is a reference to) the Messenger (saww) of Allah (azwj) by whom (saww) Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic Clarified for the people their Religion’.

‘I then asked, ‘(What about) “[91:2] And the moon when it follows the sun”? He (a.s.) said: ‘That is Amir-ul-Momineen (a.s.) following the Messenger (saww) of Allah (azwj), and emitted the knowledge by reradiating (like moon reflects the rays to the earth which fall on its surface from the sun)’.

‘I then asked, ‘(What about) “[91:4] And the night when it draws a veil over it”?’ Imam (a.s.) said: ‘That (is a reference to) the imams of the injustice who tyrannised by the command the Progeny (a.s.) of the Messenger (saww) and seated themselves upon a set which was for the Progeny (a.s.) of the Messenger (saww) who (a.s.) were higher (more deserving) for it than them. They veiled the Religion of Allah (azwj) by the injustices and the tyranny. So Allah (azwj) has Referred to their deeds by Saying “[91:4] And the night when it draws a veil over it”.

‘I then asked, (What about) “[91:3] By the Day as it shows up (the Sun’s) clarity”?’ He (a.s.) said: ‘That (is a reference to) the Imams (a.s.) from the descendants of Fatima (a.s.), when asked about the Religion of the Messenger (saww) of Allah (azwj) so they clarify it for the one who has asked (from them (a.s.)). So Allah (azwj) has referred it in His (azwj) Statement by Saying “[91:3] By the Day as it shows up (the Sun’s) clarity”.
